name: ViSpeak-Bench
description: ViSpeak-Bench evaluates models on visual + speech tasks, focusing on understanding or transcribing spoken content from video (lip-reading / audiovisual speech recognition) across clips. It measures how well models integrate visual mouth movements with audio to produce accurate transcriptions or classifications. The benchmark is intended for multimodal research on speech perception and audiovisual ASR.
reputation: Relatively new / specialized dataset with limited adoption outside audiovisual speech research communities.
